name: Dropped Connection
source:
On a sleepless night, Kiki browses her message history and overthinks the hints she still isn't sure were actually hints, wondering what could have been.

[From [url=https://moleworks.itch.io/dropped-connection]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个不眠之夜，琪琪浏览了她的消息历史记录，并过度思考了她仍然不确定的提示是否真的是提示，想知道可能是什么。

[来自[url=https://moleworks.itch.io/dropped-connection]Itch.io[/url]]
